text:
Predicates:
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x is published by y.
InLanguage(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x is translated from y.
SpecializesIn(y, z) ::: y specializes in z.
Premises:
∀x (PublishedBy(x, newVesselPress)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press.
∀x (PublishedBy(x, newVesselPress) → InLanguage(x, English)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are in English.
NeapolitanChronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press.
NeapolitanChronicles is translated from Italian.
PalaceOfFlies is a book published by New Vessel Press.
Conclusion:
PublishedBy(harryPotter, newVesselPress)
